Semantic searches found no known covering statement; negative searches do not certify uniqueness.

value.rationale: Addresses a motivated classical cyclic-factor problem by identifying the sharp maximum number of occurring rotations at every length and exactly the lengths realizing complete primitive orbits. The odd gap is a structural obstruction, while an explicit universal two-one witness achieves sharpness. Classwise doubling is stronger than the previously known aggregate dyadic cyclic complexity.
